title: The ten terms of 2r² − 3
caption: The terms of Σ(2r² − 3) for r = 1 to 10 are −1, 5, 15, 29, 47, 69, 95, 125, 159, 197. They add to 740, matching 2Σr² − Σ3 = 770 − 30.
alt: Ten boxes holding −1, 5, 15, 29, 47, 69, 95, 125, 159 and 197, with their sum 740.
description: For r = 1 to 10 the terms are −1, 5, 15, …, 197.
